next.reason: 1985: 'Division by zero always terminates the arithmetic operation and always causes a size error condition.' 2023: the size error condition exists 'if the divisor in a divide operation or in a DIVIDE statement is zero' (§2023:14.7.5 GR2); with the SIZE ERROR phrase 'the values of all of the resultant data items remain unchanged' (§2023:14.7.5, catalog GR-14.7.5-L2.1), and §2023:14.7.7 GR4 'If the size error condition is raised during the initial evaluation, none of the resultant data items are changed', so the operation is abandoned. Same requirement. The EC-SIZE-ZERO-DIVIDE handling without the phrase revises 1985's no-phrase paragraph, not this rule.
